pages.title: Egyptian Armor
pages.text: Several armor sets offer protection in the ancient lands. Each provides different benefits and aesthetics.$(br2)All armor features animated 3D models.

pages.title: Bronze Armor
pages.text: Standard protective gear:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Bronze Helmet$()$(li)$(item)Bronze Chestplate$()$(li)$(item)Bronze Leggings$()$(li)$(item)Bronze Boots$()$(br2)Provides solid protection comparable to iron.

pages.title: Veil of Anubis
pages.text: Sacred headpiece of the death god. Provides special protection and an intimidating appearance.

pages.title: Ceremonial Chestwrap
pages.text: Ancient Egyptian ceremonial armor. Lighter than bronze but imbued with protective magic.
